scripts.start: npm run build:lib && ng serve demo-app
scripts.build: ng build ngx-urlik && ng build demo-app
scripts.test: ng test ngx-urlik --watch=false && ng test demo-app --watch=false
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:lib && node type-tests/generate-large-app.mjs && vitest run --config type-tests/vitest.config.mts
scripts.clean: rm -rf dist .angular out-tsc coverage test-results playwright-report type-tests/large-app.generated.test-d.ts
scripts.release:check: npm run clean && npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run build:lib && npm test && npm run typecheck && CI=true npm run e2e && npm pack ./dist/ngx-urlik --dry-run
scripts.release: test -z "$(git status --porcelain)" || { echo 'Commit or stash every change before publishing.'; exit 1; } && npm ci && npm run release:check && npm publish ./dist/ngx-urlik --access public
